name: Happho
source:
Happho is a dragon who happens to kidnap brides to offer them a "place to stay" and then let them go... Sorry, but what kind of dragon is that??? 

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-dragon-princess]Itch.io[/url]]
